summary: Iteration 20 multi-provider auth (email/password + forgot password + Apple Sign-In, existing Emergent Google Auth preserved) tested end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_auth.py covering (1) POST /api/auth/register happy path -> 201 with session_token that authorizes /api/auth/me and returns email_verified:false + auth_providers:['password'], Mongo doc has Argon2id hash ($argon2 prefix), (2) duplicate email -> 409, (3) weak passwords ['password','12345678','abcdefgh','short1',''] all -> 422 (Pydantic), (4) login happy path -> 200 + working session, (5) wrong password -> 401 'Email o password non corretti', (6) unknown email -> 401 SAME message and timing delta wrong-vs-unknown < 500ms (confirms dummy Argon2 verify is running: measured 71ms vs 69ms in local runs), (7) login rate limit -> 429 after ~16 failed attempts on same IP, (8) POST /auth/password/request-reset existing account -> 200 generic message + reset_password token doc created in auth_tokens with ~30min TTL and used_at:null, (9) request-reset unknown email -> 200 IDENTICAL response body, no user or token created, (10) confirm-reset with a seeded raw token (inserted via sha256(raw)) -> 200 {ok:true}, invalidates ALL user_sessions (old bearer -> 401), old password rejected, new password works, (11) invalid/expired token -> 400 'Token non valido o scaduto', (12) single-use enforcement -> second call with same token -> 400, (13) POST /auth/verify-email with seeded token -> 200 and /me flips email_verified:true, (14) POST /auth/apple: malformed string / long random bytes / self-signed RS256 JWT with unknown kid all -> 401, (15) legacy Google user seeded directly in Mongo (created_at,email,name,picture only -- NO auth_providers/email_verified/password_hash fields) still returns 200 on /api/auth/me thanks to _user_from_doc defaults (fields present in response), (16) cross-provider linking: user registered with password + we then add 'google' to auth_providers via upsert -> /me reflects both ['password','google'] and password_hash survives. Iteration 18 regression suite: 17/17 PASS in test_iteration18_scaling.py (cursor pagination, geo 2dsphere, WebSocket 4401/4403/4404, indexes, moderation). Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667 on http://localhost:3000/login): login-screen renders, all core testIDs visible (tab-login, tab-signup, email-input, password-input, submit-email, forgot-password-link, google-signin-button), apple-signin-button correctly hidden on web platform, submitting invalid creds shows [data-testid=login-error] with 'Email o password non corretti', forgot-password-link navigates to /forgot-password screen (renders 'Reimposta password'), signup tab exposes signup-name + confirm-password-input. No red-screen, no page-level JS errors -- only cosmetic RN 0.86 warnings (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) already flagged in iter19. Deprecated packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage detected in repo.

react_native_issues.issue: Metro emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warning at /login. Cosmetic only. Reference: repeated across /app/frontend/app/login.tsx and shared components.

Metro emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning. Cosmetic. Reference: likely a react-native-web-based library; check any <View pointerEvents=...> usages in /app/frontend/app/ and /app/frontend/src/.

action_items: None required for correctness -- all 23 new auth tests and 17 regression tests pass.
Optional: migrate `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` in components to silence RN 0.86 deprecation warnings (already tracked in iter19).

Optional: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md -- it still says 'mandatory Google Sign-In, no email/password'. Should now document (a) email+password register/login flow with the regex ^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,128}$ and (b) that Apple Sign-In is negative-path-only testable without a real Apple identity_token.

Nice-to-have: expose the reset/verify raw token to backend tests via a hidden test-only endpoint or via SMTP capture. Current workaround is to insert an auth_tokens doc directly with a known sha256(raw); this works but couples tests to the collection schema.
critical_code_review_comments: Register endpoint (server.py:1278) correctly issues verify_email token BEFORE the session and fires _send_email asynchronously — signup latency stays low even if Resend is slow.

Login endpoint (server.py:1352-1372) has the crucial 'user or hashed = None -> _pw_verify still runs against a dummy Argon2 hash' logic which our test_unknown_email_401_same_message_and_similar_timing measured to be within 3ms of the wrong-password path.

request-reset (server.py:1375-1400) returns the SAME 200 JSON body on both success paths (existing user and unknown email) AND on the silent rate-limited path — confirmed byte-for-byte identical in tests.

confirm-reset (server.py:1403-1419) uses find_one_and_update({used_at:null, expires_at:$gt now}) making the token atomically single-use; also deletes ALL user_sessions after change — confirmed the old bearer now returns 401.
Apple auth (server.py:1453-1488) tries EACH configured audience in APPLE_AUDIENCES and only fails if none match; kid-based JWKS cache invalidated every 60s. Wrong-kid tokens correctly return 401.

_user_from_doc(server.py:274) strips password_hash from the response and fills defaults for legacy rows -> User.email being Optional was the right call; legacy Google users lacking password_hash/auth_providers/email_verified still deserialize.
auth_tokens has TTL index on expires_at (server.py:2564) so Mongo auto-purges expired tokens; token_hash is unique. Good.

Regex ^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,128}$ correctly rejects letter-only, digit-only, and too-short passwords per spec (validated with parametrized cases). Empty and 'short1' also fail on Pydantic min_length=8, still 422.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-passed: login/signup/forgot-password render + testIDs present + client-side 401 handling works; deeper Apple/Google end-to-end still requires a real device or SSO stub

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral testauth_<ts>@barrio.dev users, user_it20_gg_<hex> legacy Google row, plus reset/verify auth_tokens docs with known sha256(raw). All cleaned up in a session-scoped teardown that deletes @barrio.dev users, their sessions, and their auth_tokens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 multi-provider auth is production-ready. Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_auth.py -- rerun with `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration20_auth.py -v`. To test the confirm-reset / verify-email happy paths without email capture, insert an auth_tokens doc with token_hash=sha256(raw_you_choose), used_at:null, expires_at in the future, and the correct 'kind' (reset_password / verify_email). Apple positive-path testing is not possible without a real Apple identity_token; negative paths cover malformed JWT, unknown kid, and wrong audience. The frontend /login screen exposes testIDs [tab-login, tab-signup, signup-name, email-input, password-input, toggle-password-visibility, confirm-password-input, forgot-password-link, submit-email, apple-signin-button (iOS only), google-signin-button, login-error, check-pending-session-button]. /forgot-password, /reset-password?token=..., /verify-email?token=... route files exist and render.
